firm_data.firm_description: Mejias, Milgrim, Alvarado & Lindo, P.C. has been fighting for the rights of our clients for more than 20 years. They provide personal injury, criminal and traffic law services and take pride in getting to know their clients personally.
notable_facts: David Mejias was elected to the Nassau County Legislature in 2003.

David Mejias was named as one of Long Island Business News “40 Rising Stars Under 40” to watch, and named to the Long Island Press Power List as one of the 50 Most Powerful & Influential Long Islanders for four consecutive years.

email.subject: AI for Mejias Milgrim Alvarado & Lindo, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Dave,

Your personal injury and divorce practice in Glen Cove requires deep client relationships and precision work, not bloated enterprise tools. After 20 years fighting for clients, you know the difference between volume and results.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the region to meet practices like yours. I'd be happy to stop by your Glen Cove office to show how ex-lawyers like us are helping similar firms compete without sacrificing the personal touch your clients expect.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
